meta_title: RPC Plumbing & Heating | Emergency Plumber Hull

hero_subhead: Burst pipe or boiler breakdown in Hull? We're on your doorstep in under an hour, day or night.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing and Heating Services Across Hull
services_subhead: From emergency callouts to planned heating upgrades, we handle every aspect of your plumbing and heating needs.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and blockages fixed fast, any time of day. We carry parts on the van to get you sorted without delay.

services.title: Boiler Repairs and Servicing
services.desc: Gas Safe engineers diagnose and repair faults quickly. Annual servicing keeps your boiler running safely and efficiently.

services.title: Boiler Installation and Replacement
services.desc: New boiler fitted with a 10-year guarantee. We handle the lot — removal, installation, and system balancing.

services.title: Central Heating Installation
services.desc: Full system design and installation, including radiators, pipework, and controls. Cut your heating bills and stay warm year-round.

services.title: Bathroom Installation
services.desc: Complete bathroom overhauls — new suites, tiling, plumbing, and drainage. Finished to a high standard, on time and on budget.

services.title: Drain Unblocking and Repair
services.desc: Blocked sinks, toilets, and main drains cleared using CCTV and high-pressure jetting. We identify the root cause and fix it properly.

about_pullquote: We fix the problem right, first time, without the nonsense or inflated bills.
about_para_1: RPC Plumbing and Heating has been serving Hull and surrounding areas for over 18 years. What started as a one-man operation has grown into a trusted local team, handling everything from emergency callouts to large-scale heating installations. Every engineer is Gas Safe registered and fully insured, with the knowledge and tools to tackle whatever your home throws at us.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on speed, honesty, and fair pricing. We turn up when we say we will, explain the job clearly, and get the work done without fuss. Hundreds of Hull homeowners and landlords rely on us for their plumbing and heating — and many call us back year after year because we treat their home with the same care we'd give our own.
reviews_heading: What Hull Customers Say About RPC

reviews.text: Had a burst pipe at 11pm on a Tuesday. Called RPC and they were here by midnight. Gary sorted it in less than an hour and didn't overcharge us. Top bloke. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Needed a new boiler before winter. They gave a fair quote, fitted it cleanly, and explained everything as they went. System's working perfectly and the paperwork was all sorted. Brilliant service.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: Called them for a leaking radiator on a Saturday morning. Engineer arrived by 11, found a dodgy valve, replaced it, and flushed the system. Polite, professional, and honest about the cost. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David R.
